newsitem.title: USA: PanEnergy buys power producer stake.
newsitem.headline: PanEnergy buys power producer stake.

text.p: PanEnergy Power Services Inc said Thursday it has acquired a 32.5 percent interest in United American Energy Corp for an undisclosed amount.

This stake "will give PanEnergy additional access to power generation capabilities as well as potential fuel management, power marketing and other business opportunities," said Paula Rosput, president of PanEnergy Power Services.

A privately held company, United American is one of the oldest independent power producers in the industry. Since 1990, it has acquired and managed IPP projects, becoming a leader in remediating financially troubled assets.

United American now owns and/or operates 14 projects representing 390 megawatts of installed capacity with an original capitalization in excess of $500 million. It also operates the largest underground anthracite mine in Pennsylvania and sells coal to the metallurgical industry and to nearby power projects.

The PanEnergy Corp subsidiary said terms established under the transaction ensure that United American remains an independently operated company engaged in the ownership and management of energy assets with a focus on acquisition and remediation of distressed power projects.
In addition, PanEnergy Power and United American have agreed to pursue jointly the potential acquisition, financing and management of other electric generating facilities.
